_about: Soundcore command table. A command is two bytes, written as hex. source: openscq30 (read from OpenSCQ30's source) or soundcore_app (seen in a recording of the official app). confirmed lists the models a recording in data/soundcore/reports confirms it on. See docs/soundcore/PROTOCOL.md.

frame.checksum: The sum of every byte before it, modulo 256.
frame.vendor_service_uuid_note: The last five hex digits vary. On the A3116 and A3936 they are b and the model number.

commands.note: Request with no body; the reply carries the whole state, laid out per model.
The earbuds send it unasked when an earbud goes in or out of the case.
The earbuds send it unasked: left, right, case.
The earbuds send it unasked: left, right, 1 while charging.
Body: 1 on, 0 off.
Body: 1 on, 0 off.
Game mode on the A3947 and A3957 instead of 0187 (devices.json commands). Body: 1 on, 0 off.
The earbuds report game mode after a change: 1 on, 0 off.
The earbuds report LDAC after a change: 1 on, 0 off.
Body: 1 on, 0 off.
3D sound in the Soundcore app. Body: 1 on, 0 off.
The EQ without correction: the preset number, then each earbud's curve. The Motion+ (A3116) takes only a one-byte preset number here. Layout: docs/soundcore/PROTOCOL.md section 8.
The EQ, then each curve after OpenSCQ30's dynamic range correction; some models send other layouts on it (docs/soundcore/PROTOCOL.md section 8).
The 03 87 layout from earbuds whose age range is FF (no HearID), with the HearID parts sent as FF.
The whole EQ with the HearID data, 92 bytes on the A3936. Layout: docs/soundcore/PROTOCOL.md section 6.
Body: side (0 left, 1 right), button, action.
Body: side, button, enabled.
Reads usage counters. SoundPeter does not use it.
Clears the counters 0501 reads. Never sent by SoundPeter.
The earbuds send the sound modes after a change.
Body: the sound modes block, 6 bytes on the A3936; byte 0: 0 noise cancelling, 1 transparency, 2 normal.
With two devices on, the earbuds send one entry per known device unasked, 42 bytes each on the A3936. Each holds a device's address and name: never put them in a report.
Two devices at once. Body: 1 on, 0 off.
